channel.title: Notes by Purushottam
channel.description: Personal notes on cybersecurity, GRC, AI and football by Purushottam Khakurel.

item.title: Vendor Risk Assessment Is More Than a Questionnaire
item.description: A useful vendor review looks beyond completed answers to understand the service, the evidence and the risks that remain.

item.title: Why Security Evidence Needs Context
item.description: A document is not proof by itself. Relevance, scope, freshness and clear validation all matter in security assurance.

item.title: Practical AI Governance Starts with Knowing Where AI Is Used
item.description: A practical starting point for managing AI risk: understand the use case, protect data, verify outputs and assign ownership.

item.title: Football Teaches Us That Progress Is Built Before Match Day
item.description: Consistency, resilience, trust and everyday preparation matter as much as the final score.

item.title: GRC Is More Than Just Compliance
item.description: Good governance, risk management and compliance help organizations make better decisions and build trust.

item.title: Why Security Questionnaires Matter
item.description: A security questionnaire is a structured way to understand how an organization protects information.

item.title: AI and the Next Chapter of Cybersecurity
item.description: AI is changing how security teams detect, investigate and explain risk, while introducing new questions of its own.

item.title: What Football Teaches Us About Leadership
item.description: A football team is a reminder that leadership is built through trust, preparation, accountability and decisions under pressure.
